_note: Dated clarification for the P4 receipt negativeFixtures sentence. The P4 receipt (ala-p4-qualification-receipt.v1.json) is historical and unchanged; this record maps each advertised kind to the exact test, entry point, and failure pattern that existed at the P4 execution source. R07/F04 disposition: coverage existed partly outside the matrix file; it is now mapped explicitly. Detection classes: S = semantic rejection through the real audit entry point, C = census/count assertion, P = parsing rejection.

classes.C: census/count assertion through the audit entry point
classes.P: parsing rejection (malformed bytes never reach semantic audit)
classes.S: semantic rejection through the real audit entry point

M0.name: M0 positive control: staged case carries 7 branches plus committed batch and schedule
M0.note: positive control only; not a negative case

M1.name: M1 rejects an edited turn outcome

M2.name: M2 rejects a deleted branch bundle (census)
M2.note: R03 repair: passes the altered artifact through the real census entry point (seven-branch contract), not a bare directory count

M4.name: M4 rejects a duplicated ledger event

M5.name: M5 rejects a wrong-signature ledger event

M6.name: M6 rejects a truncated treatment batch
M6.note: R03 repair: passes the truncated artifact through the real batch reader (invalid-JSON rejection), not a bare JSON.parse

M7.name: M7 rejects a test episode injected into ordinary input

matrix.tally: M0 positive control + M1-M7 negative (6 semantic/census + 1 parsing); 8/8 green at the R07 check

blob corruption.failure: /unauthenticated/ on unauthenticated records; identical native prediction across signature envelopes
blob corruption.test: predicts identically across signature envelopes; corruption fails verification

candidate order.test: rejects mixed candidate order between payload and disclosure

cutoff.test: rejects a future ledger row past the committed cutoff

event.failure: named audit failures on edited/duplicated events
event.test: M1 rejects an edited turn outcome; M4 rejects a duplicated ledger event

parent reference.failure: /stale or foreign/ on foreign parentRunId; /pre-state/ on foreign policy ref
parent reference.test: rejects stale restore lineage and a foreign pre-state

prediction.failure: /native vector/; forged-vector rejection in payload verification
prediction.test: rejects a changed native vector; verifies its own payload and rejects forged vectors

schedule.test: audit rejects a corrupt schedule record (F1-COMM-MALFORMED); audit rejects a wrong-shape schedule record

scope: maps P4 negativeFixtures sentence to exact tests; passing tests are checks of specified cases, never scientific evidence
